items.title: Stock Market LIVE: GIFT Nifty down over 100 points; Asia markets mixed on global bond selloff
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Thursday: The GIFT Nifty indicated a sharply lower start for the Nifty50 index as a selloff in global bonds dented risk appetite. Asian markets were mixed

items.title: Stocks to watch: NSE, Exide Industries, Welspun Living, Max Estates, GHCL
items.description: NSE's shares will mark their stock market debut on BSE today, after the IPO was subscribed 5.71 times in the three-day bidding process.

items.title: Here's why Ajit Mishra is bullish on MCX, Apollo Hospitals; bearish on TCS
items.description: Stocks to buy today: The overall setup remains constructive, and MCX appears poised for the next leg of up move and potential new highs, says Ajit Mishra of Religare Broking.

items.title: NSE shares to debut today in test of investor faith in India's growth
items.description: The National Stock Exchange's ₹22,600 crore IPO was subscribed 5.7 times, but subdued retail demand and a 2-3 per cent grey-market premium point to a modest debut

items.title: Nifty showing signs of trend reversal; buy the dips says Jatin Gedia
items.description: The Nifty closed in the green above the falling channel on Wednesday indicating signs of a trend reversal, says Jatin Gedia of Teji Mandi. The analyst is bullish on Indus Towers and South Indian Bank.

items.title: Reliance Industries down 2%, at 17-month low; what's making Street nervous?
items.description: Thus far in the calendar year 2026, RIL's share price underperformed the market by plunging 22 per cent, as compared to a 13 per cent decline in the BSE Sensex.

items.title: Sensex cracks 880 pts intraday, Nifty below 23,200: 5 factors behind crash
items.description: Stock market crash: Most sectoral indices, barring pharma, traded with deep cuts. Banking and financial services stocks were the top drags in trade today.

items.title: NSE stock lists: Macquarie, PL Capital begin coverage; see up to 9% upside
items.description: At their target price, Macquarie said, the NSE stock would trade at a 2.5x PEG, broadly in line with global peers, suggesting the premium is justified on a growth-adjusted basis.

items.title: Debt markets on edge: US, Japanese yields hit multi-year highs
items.description: Asian equities were mixed as investors weighed rising bond yields, West Asia tensions and prospects for US-China talks, while the dollar retained safe-haven support

items.title: Hero Motors surges 19% in weak market; zooms 45% in two days on huge volume
items.description: Newly listed Hero Motors share price hit an intra-day high of ₹116.80, up 39% against its issue price of ₹84 per share on the BSE in Thursday's trading session.

items.title: Insurance-related stocks crack: PB Fintech, Max, HDFC Life slide up to 20%
items.description: Insurance stocks jolted: The Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (Irdai) on Wednesday proposed a phased reduction in the expenses of management (EoM) limits for insurers.

items.title: Bharat Dynamics gains 2%: What's driving defence stock in a weak market?
items.description: Domestic brokerage Emkay Global initiated coverage on Bharat Dynamics a day earlier with an 'Add' rating.

items.title: IFCI, NIACL witness a 2-month roller-coaster ride amid NSE IPO; what next?
items.description: Shares of IFCI and New India Assurance surged up to 53% in the last two months, only to erase gains amid the NSE IPO launch. Tech analysts decode strategy in these two stocks.

items.title: NSE breaks into top 10 BSE market-cap league on debut; beats HUL, Titan
items.description: NSE's market capitalisation increased to ₹4.62 trillion to reach 10th position on the BSE, following a 5% rise in Thursday's debut trading session; beating HUL, Sun Pharma and Titan in ranking.

items.title: Sonaselection shares list at 3% premium, slightly above expectations
items.description: The stock listed at ₹102 on the BSE, a 3 per cent premium and on NSE the shares debuted at a premium of 3.34 per cent to the issue price.

items.title: Avantel share price soars 9% in weak market on heavy volume
items.description: Avantel said in an exchange filing that it won a purchase order worth ₹177.35 crore for satellite communication equipment.

items.title: NSE's ₹4.45 trillion valuation nearly double that of BSE, MCX, IEX combined
items.description: NSE shares listed at ₹1800 today, up 0.84 per cent from the IPO price of ₹1,785.

items.title: NSE debut disappoints: Can it deliver long-term gains? Experts weigh in
items.description: Arun Kejriwal, founder of Kejriwal Research, said that NSE delivered a lacklustre listing and certainly well below expectations.

items.title: NSE vs BSE: Which exchange should now be the preferred bet for investors?
items.description: On a three-to-five-year view, NSE is the better play. It earned ₹3,122 crore in Q1FY27, over 3.5 times BSE's ₹873 crore.

items.title: NSE's big-bang IPO delivers quiet debut, shares list at nearly 1% premium
items.description: The ₹22,562-crore IPO received bids for 50.58 crore shares against 8.86 crore shares on offer, resulting in an overall subscription of 5.71 times.
